title: MEMIS – Epigraphic corpus of Medieval and Early Modern inscriptions in Slovenia
institution: ZRC SAZU, Inštitut za kulturno zgodovino (Gregor Pobežin); hosted by CLARIN.SI
notes: TEI XML edition (version 1.0, published 2020-12-06, on CLARIN.SI) of 51 Latin inscriptions from the Slovenian coastal towns dated 1222 to the mid-17th century, with expanded transcriptions and Slovenian translations. Counts are our own, from the TEI file: 42 inscriptions dated within or overlapping 1450-1700 (including two 'second half of 15th c.'), 904 words in their transcription divs (approximate); 7 fall outside the period and 2 are undated. Static repository deposit, no later version found.
